desc: Newspaper Clipping of the Notice to members published prior to issue of notice of 59th Annual General Meeting of Hindustan Copper Limited in Financial Express and Sangbad Pratidin on 25.08.2026 is submitted.

Newspaper Clipping of the notice to the shareholders regarding special Window for re-lodgment of transfer requests of Physical Shares published in English and Bengali Newspaper on 25.08.2026 is submitted.

With reference to earlier announcement dated August 24, 2026 regarding Offer for Sale of Shares by Promoter, The President of India, acting through and represented by the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, (the "Promoter" and the "Seller") of Hindustan Copper Ltd  ("the Company") has now informed the BSE about its intention to exercise over-subscription option for 2,90,10,721 equity shares.
Notice of 59th Annual General Meeting of Hindustan Copper Limited to be held on 23.09.2026 at 10:30 AM is submitted.
Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY 2025-26 of the Hindustan Copper Ltd along with Assurance Statement thereon is submitted.

Register of Members and share transfer Books of Hindustan Copper Ltd will remain closed from 17.09.2026 to 23.09.2026 (both days inclusive) for taking record of the Members of the company for the purpose of 59th Annual General Meeting of the company to be convened on 23.09.2026 through Video Conferencing / other Audi-video means and for declaration of dividend for FY 2025-26.

Newspaper clipping of Notice regarding 59th AGM of Hindustan Copper Ltd, Book Closure / Record Date and E-voting published after dispatch of the Notice in Financial Express and Sangbad Pratidin on 28.08.2026 is submitted.
